tasks.label: 1. First Time Setup
tasks.command: Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser -Force; python -m venv venv; .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1; python -m pip install --upgrade pip; python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: numpy pandas scikit-learn streamlit plotly matplotlib seaborn joblib; python -m pip install fairlearn reportlab
